messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] shiny.io hang
parts:
David,
I checked, and your memory usage actually looks fine. 

However, I noticed there is a typo in the URL for your application. Did you mean to go to https://bravo.shinyapps.io/periodAnalysis/ (note the capital A)? If you visit the URL that you provided (with the lower case a), you could be hitting a bug where application names are case in-sensitive, but URLs are treated case sensitively. The workaround is to always ensure you have the "correct" URL.

-Andy
